tooling: No esbuild/swc-dependent dev tooling (tsx, vitest, jest+ts-jest). This machine's
Application Control policy blocks unsigned native binaries under the user profile,
so esbuild.exe cannot spawn and its postinstall aborts the whole install.
Instead: Node 24 runs TypeScript natively (type stripping) and node:test is the
test runner. Both are zero-dependency and behave identically on CI.
tsc itself is pure JavaScript and works fine.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
